narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The minus sits in front, so it goes on the first term. Minus six y squared plus twenty three y plus twenty.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Try y as one. The card gives negative forty nine, but his answer gives thirty seven.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The minus multiplies every term inside, not only the first.
